name: Studio with Pass-Through Kitchen
description: Long narrow rental studio with a light oak floor, white walls, and an 8.5 ft flat ceiling. The open living floor is 12 by 18.5 ft. At the far end a half-wall pass-through opens to a compact kitchen nook (gray cabinets, granite ledge, white fridge, stainless range and microwave). Beside it a short hall leads to the entry door, with a louvered bifold closet facing the living room. The near wall is a wide window wall.
origin: interior floor center (0, 0, 0); floor top is Z=0

walls.Wall_N: +Y end wall, entry door in the hall
walls.Wall_Pier: full-height pier between the kitchen pass-through and the hall
walls.Halfwall: 36.5 in pony wall under the kitchen pass-through

closet.wall: south face of the closet, facing the living room

free_floor.note: Open living floor south of the pass-through, hall, and closet. Keep the hallway threshold clear: x from the pier to the closet (-0.0254 to 0.9398), y within 0.85 m of Y=1.905. The kitchen nook and entry hall are not furnishing floor.

Sofa_spot.note: Against the west wall for a sofa about 36 in deep. Yaw 90 so the front faces the east TV wall.

TV_wall.note: Floor anchor on the blank east wall. Yaw 270 so the screen faces -X into the room. Raise Z to wall-mount.

Rug_center.note: Center of an area rug between the sofa and the TV. Yaw 0 keeps an 8x10 rug's long side along the room.

Coffee_spot.note: Coffee table between the sofa and the TV.

Plant_corner.note: Southwest corner, beside the window wall.

Lamp_corner.note: Southeast corner, beside the window and clear of the TV.

Bar_spot.note: Stool or small table in front of the granite pass-through. Yaw 180 faces the kitchen.
